messages:
Alex W.: Heads-up — noticed a p99 latency jump after the 02:10 deploy. PR linked: https://git.company.com/repo/compare/PR-8427. Can someone take a quick look? Error rates + slow tails in prod.

Maria K.: Looking. CI status? any failing tests or e2e?

sre-bot: ALERT: 1958-03-17T02:25:12Z — p99 latency up 3.2x on kv-proxy route, error rate +0.9%. See dashboard: https://dash.company.com/alerts/1958-329

Jamal S.: I skimmed the PR — it changes conn pool backoff. Tests pass locally but I see a few timeouts in canary. If we can’t isolate quickly we should revert.

Linh T.: Small change I can try: tighten backoff + fallback to old connpolicy on error. Quick patch: ```diff
- backoff_ms = 250 * attempts
+ backoff_ms = min(250 * attempts, 2000)
```

DevOps Bot: CI: ubuntu-22.04 / integration — ✅, Stress-test — failed (timeout at 60s).

Ryan P.: If error rate keeps creeping we should roll back to previous commit. Can someone approve a revert? I can coordinate canary window.

Alex W.: I can open a revert PR now if folks agree. Revert command: `git revert 1a2b3c4 --no-edit && git push origin HEAD`

Maria K.: +1 to revert. We don't have clear repro and it's impacting p99. Approving revert PR when opened. :thumbsup:

Jamal S.: I'll add a post-merge smoke test and watch the canary for 20m. If green, we'll roll forward with Linh's patch as a follow-up.

Alex W.: Created revert PR: https://git.company.com/repo/compare/PR-8429-revert. Requesting merge — needs one more maintainer approval.

DevOps Bot: Deploy window available in 10 minutes. Canary target: 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 10m if stable.

Ryan P.: I'll be on watch. Jamal — ping me when smoke tests start.

Maria K.: Approved and merging revert now.

Alex W.: Revert merged and canary started: https://deploy.company.com/deploy/1357 — watching logs.

Jamal S.: Logs look cleaner so far, p99 trending down. Continuing 20m watch.

sre-bot: RECOVERY: 1958-03-17T02:50:01Z — p99 latency back to baseline, error rate normalized.

Alex W.: Thanks everyone — follow-up: Linh will open a smaller patch with additional guards and a perf test. Closing rollover thread.
